_comment: @digitaltwin/tsconfig/base.json — the settings every @digitaltwin package and app shares.
Moved here from the repo root so a consumer in another repository gets the same compiler,
not a copy of it that drifts. Nothing app- or React-specific belongs in this file.
Beyond `strict`. These are consumed by every app, so the type surface should model the
strictest settings that are livable. noUncheckedIndexedAccess is the one that catches real
bugs — arr[0] and record[key] are typed as possibly undefined, which they genuinely are.
`jsx` is here, not only in react-library.json: a leaf package that adds one .tsx file
otherwise gets no JSX transform at all, and the failure reads as a syntax error.
